$comment: Spans that tools/check-specification-quotations.ps1 would read as quotations of
docs/specification.md, and that deliberately are not. Every entry needs a reason: an exemption
without one is a silenced failure, and the script refuses to load it.
An entry matches a quotation whose normalized text starts with its normalized text, so a long
worked example can be recorded by its opening sentence. Editing that opening re-arms the check.

exemptions.text: **Status:** partial. Sections 1–3 and 6 are written from practice
exemptions.reason: A status callout about this document's own completeness, not a quotation of the contract.
A worked example of the bug report form, quoting a reporter rather than the contract.
A worked example of the specification-ambiguity report form, quoting a reporter rather than the contract.

exemptions.text: the Key directive is not implemented
exemptions.reason: The refusal text this build printed, quoted to show that it named the directive rather than the capability.

exemptions.text: the same declaration with no `*` in its value runs
exemptions.reason: The author's description of the contrasting invocation, not a clause.

exemptions.text: reach a comment in mixed content but not one sitting among element-only children
exemptions.reason: Quotes a superseded revision of this file, which the entry goes on to correct.
Quotes a superseded revision of this file, kept because a withdrawn reassurance is worth recording.

exemptions.text: a wildcard capture substituted into a directive value
exemptions.reason: The capability named in the exit-70 refusal that 3.0.0-preview.1 and 3.0.0-preview.2 printed.

exemptions.text: per-source provenance the overlay does not retain
exemptions.reason: Quotes a superseded revision of this file, which the entry goes on to show was wrong.

exemptions.text: a native JSON or YAML document wrote a mapping here
exemptions.reason: The author's statement of the one fact the warning needs, not a clause.

exemptions.text: 'key=nm' needs an ordered mapping, and this path projects a sequence or a scalar only
exemptions.reason: A TYPE001 diagnostic message. Diagnostic text is governed by the registry, not by prose in the specification.

exemptions.text: puts a path §16.10 has just removed back into the overlay tree
exemptions.reason: Quotes a rejected-fix note this entry used to carry, kept because the reasoning was wrong for an instructive reason.

exemptions.text: places each attribute after the first on its own line
exemptions.reason: Quotes §16.9 as it read before #53 amended it. The entry exists to record that the clause moved, so it must keep the old wording.

exemptions.text: the code was already like that
exemptions.reason: A characterization of an argument the entry declines to make, not a quotation of anything.

exemptions.text: create this link before the run
exemptions.reason: A hypothetical reserved fixture name that Appendix C does not define.
